title: Parsing Gigabytes of JSON per Second
relevance: The foundational paper for SIMD structural indexing. Introduces parallel bit stream classification, PCLMULQDQ quote pairing, and two-stage parsing architecture that directly applies to CSV.

title: A Case Study in SIMD Text Processing with Parallel Bit Streams: UTF-8 to UTF-16 Transcoding
relevance: Pioneered the parallel bit stream technique for text processing, showing how to transpose byte data into bitplanes for SIMD-parallel character classification.

title: High Performance XML Parsing Using Parallel Bit Stream Technology
relevance: Extended parallel bit streams to XML parsing, demonstrating the technique's applicability to structured text formats with delimiter/escape semantics similar to CSV.

title: Scanning HTML at Tens of Gigabytes Per Second on ARM Processors
relevance: Shows SIMD structural scanning at multi-GB/s on ARM NEON, directly relevant to CSV parsing on ARM64 platforms.

title: Mison: A Fast JSON Parser for Data Analytics
relevance: Introduced speculative structural indexing for JSON — builds structural indices to map logical to physical field locations, converting control flow to data flow.

title: simdcsv (Rust) - Exploring novel algorithms to parse rows of CSV 64 bytes at a time using pclmulqdq
relevance: Direct implementation of simdjson-style SIMD CSV parsing in Rust, using vectorized classification and PCLMULQDQ for 64-byte-at-a-time row parsing.
